summary: TWT Phase 5 final micro-retest. (1) RED DeadlineBadge opacity fix VERIFIED: sampled getComputedStyle(...).opacity 12x over ~2.4s on all 4 seeded badges ('In 2d' red, 'In 5d' yellow, 'In 30d' green, 'Expired 4d ago' red) — all constant at 1.0 (min=1.0, max=1.0), min >> 0.9. Scale pulse still alive on red badges only (9 distinct transform values over 1.8s vs 1 for yellow/green), so the per-prop transition split works as intended. (2) Dead KmTotal removal VERIFIED: [data-testid=km-total] count = 0 on the trip page, while [data-testid=trip-km-total] renders 'KM total: 1573 km' correctly (matches /api/trips/{id}/summary total_km=1573.0). (3) Backend regression suite fully green: 211 passed / 0 failed in 42s. Phase 5 acceptance criteria met. One pre-existing (unrelated to this phase) cosmetic defect found on the Dashboard trip card.

ui_bugs.issue: Dashboard trip card renders hardcoded placeholders '0 km', '0 {home_currency}' and 'phase 1' instead of real totals. For the seeded trip the card shows '0 km / 0 EUR' while the trip page + /api/trips/{id}/summary report 1573 km / EUR 480 — misleading data for the user. /api/trips list does not return totals, so either enrich the list response or fetch summary per card.

action_items: Optional (out of Phase 5 scope): replace hardcoded '0 km' / '0 {currency}' / 'phase 1' placeholders in TripCard.jsx with real trip totals (extend /api/trips list payload with total_km + total_cost_home_currency, or lazily fetch summary per card).
critical_code_review_comments: HotelList.jsx DeadlineBadge: per-prop transition split (scale repeat:Infinity, opacity one-shot 0.25s) is the correct Framer Motion fix — no keyframe array on opacity, so no dip. Verified empirically.
Trip.jsx no longer contains the unused KmTotal function; no other reference to data-testid=km-total remains anywhere in /app/frontend/src.
TripCard.jsx placeholders are dead/faked UI data — should be wired or removed to avoid the same 'dead component' class of issue just cleaned up in Trip.jsx.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 2 targeted Phase 5 checks (badge opacity, km-total removal)

Trip page route is /trip/{trip_id}; hotels render expanded by default (no stop click needed). Only open item is the cosmetic hardcoded '0 km / 0 EUR / phase 1' footer in TripCard.jsx on the dashboard.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous red-badge flicker was caused by a single shared transition (repeat:Infinity) applied to both scale and opacity, making Framer Motion loop the opacity 0->1 entry animation as well. Splitting transitions per property (opacity one-shot 0.25s) confines the repeat to scale only. Confirmed by measurement: opacity stays 1.0 while transform keeps changing.
